name: charred sanctuary floor
description: Ash and scorched stone cover what remains of Flora's sanctuary. The grove no longer quiets the Brand.

name: ward-bound embers
description: Glowing embers held inside a ring of Flora's dying ward. They give light but cannot spread fire; the escape paths remain clear.

name: Flora's broken ward
description: The protective mark has burned cold. The Brand is no longer quieted here.

name: ash-marked escape path
description: Pale marks trace a clear path from the house toward the western road or southern garden.

name: charred sanctuary wall
description: The blackened shell of Flora's sanctuary. The walls no longer protect a peaceful haven.
